verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms a public pricing page exists (mailgun.com/pricing) listing some plan features like dedicated IP pools, SAML SSO, and a free tier limit of 100 emails/day, suggesting some self-serve pricing info without a sales call. However, there's no evidence of explicit per-volume tier breakdowns, overage rate details, or standalone add-on pricing for validation services. missing for 10: explicit volume-tier pricing table, overage/per-email rate details, validation add-on cost, independent confirmation that full pricing (including enterprise tiers) is accessible without contacting sales.
